claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says starseeds may find conventional jobs incompatible and struggle to remain in them, so she recommends seeking income through enjoyable work.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu argues that social attitudes stigmatize earning money from spiritual, healing, or extraterrestrial work, limiting starseeds’ income.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes money as a tool that can support good or harmful ends, and says it remains necessary on Earth despite post-scarcity societies elsewhere.
